description.value: Taco Nori is a fast-casual fusion concept inside downtown Vancouver's Bentall Centre, serving nori tacos made with deep-fried seaweed shells filled with fresh sushi-style ingredients like Atlantic salmon, ahi tuna, and avocado. The concept originated at the Richmond Night Market in 2018 under the name Nori Express and expanded to a fleet of three food trucks and a trailer before opening its first permanent storefront. It sits along the busy Burrard Street corridor, making it a quick and inventive lunch stop for cyclists moving through the financial district.
